title: Add Git provenance and per-file change semantics

state.decision_rationale: Accepted as MKTCTX/4 Git working-tree provenance and typed change records, including deletions, renames, and base blob hashes.

provenance.review_target: Reported 396-file MKTCTX/3 packet; exact artifact not identified

feedback.verbatim: Git provenance is the critical missing feature. For a code review packet, I need to know branch, HEAD commit, comparison base, dirty status, added/modified/deleted/renamed state per file, and base blob hash where applicable. Right now I can review the state, but I cannot tell what you changed versus what was already in the repository. A projection=diff mode would also be valuable, while still allowing the exact final file to be included when needed.
feedback.normalized_claim: Bind review packets to explicit Git state and comparison provenance, including per-file change status and base content identity.

current_behavior: Packets identify selection kind and order but do not record branch, HEAD, comparison base, dirty state, or Git object IDs.
A piped git diff --name-only list becomes an explicit stdin selection, but the pipe discards change status and comparison provenance before mktxt reads it.
Files carry final source hashes but no base blob hashes or added, modified, deleted, and renamed state.
The sidecar diff compares previous aggregate outputs; it is not a repository base-to-head diff projection.
evidence: src/context.ts: ContextPacket and ContextManifest selection metadata

proposal.summary: Evaluate optional Git-aware packet metadata and a review projection that preserves base, head, dirty-state, and per-file change provenance.
candidate_changes: Add a versioned @vcs block containing VCS kind, branch or detached state, HEAD commit, base ref, resolved base commit, worktree dirty posture, and acquisition errors.
Add per-file added, modified, deleted, renamed, copied, unmerged, and untracked status plus base path and base blob hash when applicable.
Preserve deleted paths as explicit change records even when no final source body exists.
Evaluate projection=diff as a review representation while allowing exact final files and base files to coexist when required.
Distinguish committed head state, index state, and working-tree state instead of collapsing them into one dirty boolean.
non_goals: Do not infer Git provenance from a plain list of paths after the producing command has discarded it.
Do not make Git mandatory for explicit non-repository manifests.
Do not label previous-output sidecar differences as repository diffs.

questions: Should Git metadata be automatically captured during repository discovery, explicitly requested, or supplied in an enriched stdin manifest?
Which state is authoritative when HEAD, index, and worktree differ?
How should shallow clones, missing base refs, submodules, worktrees, and unborn branches be represented?
Should exact base content be included, retrievable by object ID, or represented only by hashes and diffs?
risks: Implicit Git inspection could make otherwise deterministic path packaging depend on mutable repository state.
A single dirty flag can conceal staged versus unstaged distinctions that matter in review.
Diff-only representations can omit context required for correct reasoning.
Repository object IDs and branch names may disclose provenance the caller did not intend to share.
evidence_needed: A normative state model covering HEAD, index, worktree, untracked files, deletes, renames, and conflicts.
Fixtures for branches, detached HEAD, shallow history, missing bases, renames, deletes, and dirty worktrees.
Model evaluation comparing exact-only packets with VCS-aware review packets.
Token and size measurements for diff, exact-final, and base-plus-final alternatives.
decision_dependencies: Decide whether MKTCTX remains VCS-neutral at its core or defines an optional Git extension.
